extension.description: Reviews HTTP execution and OpenCollection workspace mutations through the Probe CLI.
extension.name: Probe command protection

permissions.description: Identifies deletion of an environment from an OpenCollection workspace.
permissions.label: Probe environment deletion
safer_guidance: Confirm the exact environment and dependent environments before deletion.

permissions.description: Identifies Probe commands that create or modify persisted OpenCollection environments.
permissions.label: Probe environment workspace mutation
safer_guidance: Inspect the selected environment and variable names before persisting changes.

permissions.description: Identifies deletion of a folder from an OpenCollection workspace.
permissions.label: Probe folder deletion
safer_guidance: Confirm the exact folder selector and its contents before deletion.

permissions.description: Identifies Probe commands that create or modify folders in an OpenCollection workspace.
permissions.example_command: probe folder rename api.yml items/0 --name Accounts
permissions.label: Probe folder workspace mutation
safer_guidance: Inspect the selected folder and workspace status before persisting changes.

permissions.description: Identifies deletion of a request from an OpenCollection workspace.
permissions.label: Probe request deletion
safer_guidance: Confirm the exact request selector and retain a recoverable workspace copy before deletion.

permissions.description: Identifies Probe request execution that writes the response body to a local file.
permissions.example_command: probe request run api.yml items/0 --output response.json
permissions.label: Probe response file write
safer_guidance: Review the output path and existing destination before writing the response body.

permissions.description: Identifies HTTP request execution through the Probe CLI.
permissions.example_command: probe request run api.yml items/0 --environment production
permissions.label: Probe request execution
safer_guidance: Inspect the request, selected environment, and runtime variable names before execution.

permissions.description: Identifies Probe commands that create or modify requests in an OpenCollection workspace.
permissions.example_command: probe request set api.yml items/0 --method POST
permissions.label: Probe request workspace mutation
safer_guidance: Inspect the selected request and workspace status before persisting changes.
